objective: Audit and design environmental protection and green space mechanics with sustainable double-entry funding. Ensure national parks, landscape parks, nature reserves, and buffer zones are compatible with the parcel system and can dynamically grow/shrink/be created/be abolished. Design urban recreation parks with minor infrastructure that boosts happiness, increases recreation access, and reduces local pollution. Define strict economic and management models with revenue mechanisms: park entry fees collected via C2G (Citizen-to-Government) administrative fee routing, and ecological/conservation taxes debited from industrial firm ledgers.
constraints: RAM protection: cargo check and cargo clippy only
Rule 1: Park management costs must debit a real government ledger with strict counterparty; no fiat creation.
Rule 2: Park management costs, entry fees, and ecological tax must scale by protected_area, visitor_count, and average_wage, not flat rates
Rule 4: Parks must have complete lifecycle: creation, growth, shrinkage, abolition
Rule 5: Land allocation for parks must use the parcel system
Rule 7: Each park's revenue, costs, and ecological health must remain individually tracked
Rule 9: Park parcel mutations must respect Rust borrow rules — use cadastre index lookups
Rule 15: Park infrastructure must scale by total_area and visitor_count
Rule 19: Green space expansion must physically annex cadastre parcels
Rule 21: Park management must use cost-plus pricing with CAPEX amortization
Rule 22: Do not modify military, fertilizer, sports, or housing modules
Rule 23: Surgically extend politics/conservation.rs and society/geography.rs

C2G FEE ROUTING: Government entry fees use C2G administrative fee collection via state/tax.rs patterns (not B2C retail). Citizen Labor accounts debited, country.budget park sub-account credited. Ecological taxes debited from company.liquid_capital, credited to same park sub-account. If revenue < costs, ecological_health degrades proportionally.
api_contracts: state/src/politics/conservation.rs — Add NatureReserve and BufferZone structs with parcel linkage; add entry_fee and ecological_tax fields to NationalPark and LandscapePark
state/src/politics/funding.rs — Add ParkFundingSource with C2G administrative fee routing
state/src/state/tax.rs — Add park_entry_fee collection (income tax pattern) and ecological_tax collection (corporate tax pattern)
state/src/society/cadastre.rs — Add parcel annexation/release API for park creation/expansion/abolition
state/src/environment/ — Add urban park pollution reduction and happiness boost mechanics; add ecological tax assessment based on pollution proximity
completion_criteria: Parks can be created, expanded, shrunk, and abolished via parcel system. Park entry fees collected via C2G administrative fee routing. Ecological taxes debited from industrial firm ledgers. Park net cost is sustainable. Urban parks boost happiness and reduce pollution. M0 conservation maintained. Iron CI/CD green.
harmonization_notes: v5 resubmission. No content changes from v4 — rejected only for re-harmonization. Updated roadmap reference to roadmap-005. C2G fee routing via state/tax.rs remains as designed.
